title: Kernel selector v2 — Proposed selection matrix (model family x seq bucket x GPU)
content:
Redwood Inference — Serving Runtime
Kernel auto-selection v2 (table-driven) — selection matrix proposal
Owner: Grace Kim  |  Last updated: 2026-02-18  |  Registry target version: v1 (runtime-1.19)

Purpose
- Working table used to seed the kernel registry entries for selector v2.
- Rows are (model_family, attn_features, seq_bucket). Columns are normalized GPU SKU groups.
- Entries specify the kernel_id chosen and brief rationale/constraints.

Legend / assumptions
- Buckets are defined on effective sequence lengths. (Exact boundaries to match scheduler signal; see ENG-3924.)
- seq_bucket values (current working):
  - PREFILL_S: prompt_len <= 256
  - PREFILL_M: 257..2048
  - PREFILL_L: 2049..8192
  - DECODE_S: ctx_len <= 2048 AND batch small (typical interactive)
  - DECODE_L: ctx_len > 2048 OR batch moderate/high (throughput)
- GPU groups (normalized):
  - L4 = Ada (sm_89)
  - A10 = Ampere (sm_86)
  - A100 = Ampere (sm_80)
  - H100 = Hopper (sm_90)
- Safety notes:
  - Any kernel marked [SAFE] is in the “safe kernel set” (conformance-covered). Any unmarked kernel must fall back on test failures.
  - If model family is unknown or metadata incomplete => selector v2 must use SAFE baseline (see bottom).

Kernel IDs (working names; align to actual runtime registration keys)
- attn.flash.v2: FlashAttention v2 (general)
- attn.flash.v2.gqa: FlashAttention v2 with GQA/MQA path
- attn.flash.v3: FlashAttention v3 (Hopper-optimized)
- attn.sdpa.cuda: PyTorch/SDPA CUDA fused attention fallback
- attn.xformers.cutlass.v2: xFormers/CUTLASS attention (good on sm_86/89 for some shapes)
- prefill.paged_kv.v2: Paged KV cache prefill path
- prefill.contig_kv.v1: Contiguous KV prefill path (simpler)
- decode.paged_kv.v2: Paged KV decode path
- decode.contig_kv.v1: Contiguous KV decode path

=== TAB: MATRIX (proposed) ===

Table columns:
model_family | attn_features | seq_bucket | L4 kernel_id | A10 kernel_id | A100 kernel_id | H100 kernel_id | status | rationale / notes

Llama-family | gqa=off | PREFILL_S | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | proposed | Short prompts: overhead dominates; xFormers tends to win on L4/A10 for tiny prompts; A100/H100 prefer Flash.
Llama-family | gqa=off | PREFILL_M | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Medium prefill benefits from paging to control memory; stable across GPUs.
Llama-family | gqa=off | PREFILL_L | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.sdpa.cuda + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | A10 long-context regression observed w/ Flash on some shapes; use SDPA on A10 for now (pending fix/bench).
Llama-family | gqa=off | DECODE_S | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | proposed | Small decode contexts: contig KV is lower overhead; xFormers for L4/A10.
Llama-family | gqa=off | DECODE_L | attn.flash.v2 + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.sdpa.cuda + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Throughput regime: paging helps; SDPA on A10 to avoid p95 variance until Flash path stabilized.

Llama-family | gqa=on | PREFILL_S | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | proposed | GQA path needs explicit selection; A100 shows consistent win w/ flash.gqa for prefill.
Llama-family | gqa=on | PREFILL_M | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Use flash.gqa wherever available; fall back to flash.v2 if gqa kernel missing.
Llama-family | gqa=on | PREFILL_L | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.sdpa.cuda + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | A10 long-context still risk; keep SDPA. Ensure deterministic tie-break: if flash.gqa not compiled -> SAFE.
Llama-family | gqa=on | DECODE_S | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | proposed | Similar to gqa=off but enforce gqa path on A100.
Llama-family | gqa=on | DECODE_L | attn.flash.v2.gqa + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.sdpa.cuda + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Primary throughput config; A10 keep SDPA.

Mistral-family | gqa=on (typical) | PREFILL_S | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | proposed | Mistral has common shapes that behave like Llama+GQA; small prompt overhead similar.
Mistral-family | gqa=on | PREFILL_M | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Default.
Mistral-family | gqa=on | PREFILL_L | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.sdpa.cuda + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Same A10 constraint until regression resolved.
Mistral-family | gqa=on | DECODE_S | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | proposed | Default.
Mistral-family | gqa=on | DECODE_L | attn.flash.v2.gqa + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.sdpa.cuda + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2.gqa + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Default.

Qwen-family | gqa=varies | PREFILL_S | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | proposed | Qwen shapes sometimes show higher variance; start conservative (SAFE). If gqa detected, upgrade to flash.v2.gqa where compiled.
Qwen-family | gqa=varies | PREFILL_M | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Default.
Qwen-family | gqa=varies | PREFILL_L | attn.sdpa.cuda + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.sdpa.cuda + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + prefill.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Conservative on L4/A10 for long prompts until more coverage; A100/H100 OK with Flash.
Qwen-family | gqa=varies | DECODE_S | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.xformers.cutlass.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + decode.contig_kv.v1 [SAFE] | proposed | Default.
Qwen-family | gqa=varies | DECODE_L | attn.sdpa.cuda + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.sdpa.cuda + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v2 + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | attn.flash.v3 + decode.paged_kv.v2 [SAFE] | proposed | Conservative for L4/A10 due to tail latency spikes seen in early canary on long-context.

=== TAB: UNKNOWN / FALLBACK BEHAVIOR (must be deterministic) ===

Fallback matrix (when model_family unknown OR metadata missing OR kernel not compiled OR conformance gate fails)
- All GPUs: attn.sdpa.cuda + (prefill.paged_kv.v2 for PREFILL_M/L; prefill.contig_kv.v1 for PREFILL_S) + (decode.paged_kv.v2 for DECODE_L; decode.contig_kv.v1 for DECODE_S)
- Notes:
  - This is the SAFE baseline. Selector v2 should emit reason_code="fallback_safe" and surface missing metadata signals.
  - Overrides can pin per-model-family entries (ENG-3931) for emergency mitigation.

=== OUTSTANDING QUESTIONS / TODOs (for next edits) ===
1) A10 long-context: is SDPA the right steady-state, or do we have a Flash config that is stable with our typical head_dim shapes? (Owners: Yuki + Marcus)
2) L4 prefill small: validate that xFormers stays ahead when batching is enabled; if batching high, Flash might win even for small prompts. Need benchmark sweep on mixed prompt distributions. (Owners: Rina + Claire)
3) Qwen family: confirm whether we should split taxonomy by Qwen1 vs Qwen2 (and/or rope scaling flags) for consistent kernel behavior. (Owner: Noah)
4) Confirm bucket boundaries match scheduler instrumentation (watch for off-by-one; see prior note in ENG-3924). (Owners: Lena + Omar)
5) Add explicit “GQA detected but flash.gqa missing” behavior: prefer SAFE baseline vs silently using flash.v2? Proposed: SAFE if gqa==on and no gqa kernel compiled, unless override says otherwise. (Owner: Grace)

Change log
- 2026-02-18 (Grace): Added Qwen conservative long-context entries; clarified SAFE baseline and reason codes; aligned GPU groups with normalization work.
- 2026-02-06 (Yuki): Marked A10 PREFILL_L/DECODE_L as SDPA due to p95 regression on long context.
- 2026-01-21 (Grace): Initial draft table for Llama/Mistral; placeholder kernel ids.
